results.title: Juliette in Spring
results.overview: Juliette goes back in her hometown to spend some time with her family. She finds herself between a loving but moody father, a New Age mother, a sister in the midst of an existential crisis, and a grandmother slowly losing her mind. Buried memories and family secrets rise to the surface in this sweet, tender and sometimes extravagant family portrait.

results.title: Whatever City
results.overview: Ida bumps into her old music teacher from elementary school. This unexpected meeting sets off a journey through a city where many people speak, but few manage to express anything worthwhile.

results.title: The Caregiver
results.overview: Emma takes a job as a caregiver for a senile old woman. Strange things start happening in the house. What Emma doesn't know is that the house hides a terrifying secret.

results.title: Devi Danger
results.overview: In the near future the NeuroTic Corporation harnesses AI processing power by using humans as brain cattle via a neuro-network human brain implants.

results.title: Baby Brother
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Benny has to endure everything his older brother, Pascal, does. But when Pascal shows weakness on New Year's Eve, Benny senses he has a chance for revenge. His decision will have fatal consequences.

results.title: Meltdown
results.overview: A talk show host begins to lose his mind due to a particularly irritating guest.

results.title: Craft
results.overview: When Max and Bonnie kill Travis - their high school bully - the plan goes off without a hitch. However, when they try to bury him, they discover that his legs are too long. So begins a hectic night of shenanigans as they try to cut him down to size. But while Max grows ever confident that she has found her calling, Bonnie might not be as certain…

results.title: The Farm
results.overview: Calvin and Hanna's relationship comes under threat when their Brazilian holiday resort turns out to be an experimental therapy centre.

results.title: Amateur Night
results.overview: The regular crowd at The Silver Bullet Gentleman's Club get more than they bargained for when the new dancer has a thirst for more than just money.

results.title: Madu
results.overview: From practicing barefoot on the streets of Lagos to performing on stage in England, twelve year old Anthony Madu leaves his home in Nigeria to study at one of the most prestigious ballet schools in the world. Anthony, who had barely left his neighborhood in Lagos, finds himself thrust into a new world where his wildest dream is suddenly within reach. His journey is a story of extraordinary obstacles, courage, growth, and ultimately, his search for belonging.

results.title: Pungut
results.overview: Two gangs are fighting to gain control of a junkyard, with a father-son conflict entrenched in the middle.

results.title: Roy
results.overview: Following a break-in at his home, something cracks in the unity of Roy’s family and leaves open scars. Roy, a decorated special forces fighter in the past, decides not to remain indebted and takes "the law" into his own hands.

results.title: Grrr..
results.overview: Heartbroken and intoxicated, Rejimon stumbles into a lion's den at the zoo. Haridas, a guard, has to forcefully dive in to rescue him, earning media attention for the blunder.

results.title: The Chronicles of Libidoists
results.overview: Four individuals, adrift in their pursuit of sexual gratification, find themselves inextricably linked by a shared longing for a deeper, purer connection that transcends carnal desires.

results.title: Lost Ladies
results.overview: In 2001, somewhere in rural India, two young brides get accidentally swapped on a train. In the ensuing chaos, they both encounter a host of colourful characters, resulting in hilarious and unexpected consequences.

results.title: Chiefsaholic: A Wolf in Chiefs Clothing
results.original_title: Chiefsaholic: A Wolf in Chiefs Clothing
results.overview: Recognized for his distinctive wolf costume and boisterous social media antics, Xaviar  Babudar aka ChiefsAholic rose to fame as one of Kansas City's most fervent fans. However, a secret life came to light when he was arrested in Bixby, Oklahoma, unraveling a series of unsolved bank robberies committed across the Midwest.

results.title: Berta
results.overview: Berta wants Alex to understand the harm he caused her years ago and will do whatever it takes to explain it to him.

results.title: Reviled
results.overview: Hannah meets a mysterious man with a key to her past. In her struggle for the truth, an invisible enemy threatens to take her life.
